extracted.name: Southern Sweet Ham Glaze
extracted.description: This delicious Southern ham glaze recipe covers a ham in bourbon, molasses, spices, and mustard to make a mouthwatering dish that everyone will love.
instruction_lines: Place brown sugar, molasses, mustard, bourbon, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, and black pepper in a mixing bowl and stir until sugar has dissolved.
